evidence.quote: For today's talk, I narrow in on the types of research done at central banks, with a focus on the Federal Reserve.
In conclusion, I expect research to remain an important part of policymaking at the Fed and other central banks.
For example, the April 2 tariff announcement was larger and more extensive than nearly anyone expected.
